A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AUSSM research. The complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices support reliable comparison, including v2's added related-work appendix and checklist.

before.justification: v1 reports original runtime and memory measurements, algorithmic-task evaluations, time-series classification results, and weather forecasting results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds results for two Mamba variants in Table 1.

M1.justification: The input-dependent unitary recurrence, AUSSM–Mamba hybrid, separable convolution, and CUDA procedure are retained. The revised discretization description leaves Equation 4 and the appendix derivation unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same algorithmic tasks, six UEA classification datasets, Weather forecasting task, and scalability scenarios. The additional Mamba variants are evaluated within existing task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds Mamba Complex and Mamba [-1,1] alongside the existing comparators. This extends one benchmark comparison with two related variants; the scalability, classification, and forecasting comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The stated sequence lengths, sample counts, metrics, hyperparameter searches, hardware, and testing procedures for retained experiments are unchanged. v2 does not document a separate protocol revision for the added baseline columns.

E4.justification: The existing scalability and length-generalization evaluations are retained. The added Mamba variants are presented as benchmark comparators; no separate component ablation, sensitivity study, robustness test, error analysis, or case study is introduced.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 newly identifies the classification uncertainty terms as standard deviations and reports a weather standard deviation of 0.0173. The previously reported seed counts and 50-run timing averages remain unchanged; additional runs are not established.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds nine-task results for each new Mamba variant, including parity scores of 0.27 for Mamba Complex and 1.0 for Mamba [-1,1]. Retained model scores and Figure 2's curves are unchanged. v2 also reports the weather standard deviation and removes Figure 1's isolated parity percentages.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 adds explicit cited circuit-complexity bounds, the TC0 != NC1 assumption, and formal expressivity comparisons for additional recurrent-model variants. The original AUSSM derivations, proofs, and precision analysis are retained; renaming Corollary 1 as Theorem 2 adds no new result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the claims about counting, hybrid solvable-language recognition, scalable computation, and empirical usefulness. Section 3's revised wording makes the hybrid/diagonal qualification consistent with the formal result already stated in v1.

C2.justification: Appendix A.3 interprets complex Mamba's weak empirical learning despite equal formal expressivity as support for the unitary restriction. Appendix B clarifies fixed-size capacity versus architecture-class expressivity. Sections 4 and 6 add qualifications concerning tensor-core implementations and absolute GPU speed.

D1.justification: v2 adds a repository pointer in the abstract and checklist disclosures about synthetic-task dataloaders and a CUDA installation/testing README. Existing implementation listings, hyperparameters, and hardware details are retained. These are newly reported access details, not externally verified resources.

R1.justification: New Appendix A substantially expands positioning through unitary/orthogonal RNNs, conserved neural dynamics, and comparisons with negative/complex Mamba, RWKV-7, and DeltaProduct. v2 also removes v1's direct discussion and citation of structured state-space duality in Section 4.

P1.justification: Most existing prose and the main section order remain intact. Changes include local copyediting, a numbered Formal Expressivity subsection, revised automata terminology, added explanatory passages, and reordered experimental appendix subsections, alongside the new related-work appendix and checklist.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is substantially redesigned around a language-class hierarchy and revised block diagrams, replacing the scalability diagram and parity illustration. Table 1 expands with two comparator columns, and new Tables 4–5 summarize theoretical comparisons. Figures 2–3 and the remaining existing tables are retained, with some relocation.

improvement.justification: The added comparators, clearer expressivity scope, expanded research positioning, code-access information, and weather uncertainty disclosure make v2 easier to assess and reproduce. These provide a limited net improvement. Sparse implementation details for the new baselines and removal of the direct structured-state-space-duality comparison leave some comparison gaps.
